title: Evaluation case p5-single-laptop: one laptop cannot sign in to Teams because it holds no primary refresh token
scenario: One laptop cannot sign in to Teams because it holds no primary refresh token.

events.title: Cannot sign in on my laptop
events.text: My laptop will not sign in to Teams since yesterday. My teammates sitting next to me are fine on their own machines.

events.title: Re: Cannot sign in on my laptop
events.text: Hello, I am sorry about that. Could your IT admin confirm that only this device is affected, and try removing the Teams cache and reinstalling the app?

events.title: Re: Cannot sign in on my laptop
events.text: Confirmed, it is only this one device. We removed the cache folder and reinstalled Teams and nothing changed. Teams in the browser on the same laptop signs in without any problem.

events.title: Device registration check
events.text: The device registration status from the laptop says it is joined to the tenant, but there is no primary refresh token on it.

events.title: Next step
events.text: Please disconnect the laptop from the tenant, restart it, and join it again with the work account.

events.title: Re: Next step
events.text: After joining the laptop again it signs in normally.
